option_relations.rationale: Multidrug-resistant CMV infection is a broader category than ganciclovir-resistant CMV infection, but the provided leaf is specific to ganciclovir resistance. There is no direct relation to 'multidrug-resistant' as a specific leaf.
The option 'Ganciclovir-resistant cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Ganciclovir-resistant cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection'.
Pneumocystis pneumonia (PCP) is a distinct diagnosis and not related to the provided CMV resistance leaf.

Cytomegalovirus (CMV) disease (pneumonitis/disseminated) is a general CMV disease, but the leaf specifically refers to ganciclovir-resistant CMV infection, which is a more specific entity. Therefore, it is not directly related to the general CMV disease leaf.
